answer: Identity-bond natural decay stops fake identities. An agent posts a bond equal to twice its 30-day earnings, decaying 5% each epoch unless honest work renews it. Shells starve, a lantern dimming without fuel, while a record grows like a vine fed by tasks, a reef alive with upkeep. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bonds plus fees each epoch, dwarfing pooled rewards. An honest agent pays once, renews by working, and keeps undiluted rewards.
